file_id: Altab Mandal & Ors vs Unknown on 12 August, 2024

sentences.text: Altab Mandal & Ors vs Unknown on 12 August, 2024

Author: Suvra Ghosh
Bench: Suvra Ghosh
 21
12-08-2024
Ct. No.34 b.das Crr No. 3436 of 2023 + Cran 1 of 2023 In the matter of : Altab Mandal & Ors.
..... petitioners.

Mr. Shibaji Kumar Das Mr. D. Sarkar ...for the petitioners. Mr. Omar Faruk Gazi Mr. Maidul Islam
Mr. N. A. Mallick Ms. Susmita Das ...for the opposite party.
In Re: CRAN 1 of 2023 Heard learned counsels for the parties.
Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioners are the members of the matrimonial family of the private opposite party.
Charge sheet has been submitted under Section 498A/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
No offence as alleged has been made out against the petitioners either in the complaint or in course of investigation.

Learned counsel has taken this Court to an application filed by the petitioner/de facto complainant under the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 against the principal accused who is her husband and is not one of the petitioners herein.

entities.text: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The application does not contain any allegation of domestic violence against the present petitioners.

Per contra, learned counsel for the private opposite party submits that a Narazi application has been filed by the private opposite party/de facto complaint before the learned Trial Court against the charge sheet submitted by the investigating officer upon holding causal investigation in the matter.
The said application has been fixed for hearing on 13th November, 2024.
In view of the above, the matter is adjourned.
Let the matter appear under the same heading on 20th November, 2024.

( Suvra Ghosh, J. )
